CA.rationale: No explicit attention-to-organization relation is clearly linked to the identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (red locations) and a separate organization/presentation field (origin) are both explicitly present and bound to the same referent/time.

A.rationale: Report lists current vs candidate items and origin/process meta-data but does not explicitly link an attention/allocation condition to the same content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: Explicit identified content (color 'red') and its coordinates are listed for a named referent and time.

D.rationale: Content (red coordinates) is specified separately from its status/origin metadata, distinguishing identification from organization/status.

O.rationale: An explicit origin/representation-time field describes how the content is organized/presented for the named referent/time.
